REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Token counters permit fractional numbers, leaving gaps between the integer threshold branches. An accepted attempt above 500k effective tokens can therefore avoid the mandatory reflection checkpoint.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.execution-receipt-v1.schema.json|Token and effective-token fields allow any number, while threshold conditions begin at 200001 and 500001|A fractional value above 500000 matches no reflection branch, violating the required 500k warning/reflection control
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Define token counters and effective_tokens as nonnegative integers, or use exclusiveMinimum boundaries that cover every numeric value; add a rejecting fixture for a fractional value above 500000.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An otherwise valid accepted receipt with input_tokens=500000.5, output_tokens=0, effective_tokens=500000.5, status=target_exceeded, and no reflection_ticket_id passes the schema and relationship validator.
